name: Mage
fantasy: The spell duelist. Runes you, hexes you into a critter, blinks away and snaps back.

card.loop: Bolt a foe to Rune them; your next spell on them detonates it (Overcharged: a Flashpoint). Hex, Blink, snap back.
card.dash: Blink up to 5.5m (through walls); dash again within 3s to snap back to the sigil you left.
card.passive: Runes: a second spell on a Runed foe detonates it (16, root). Heat 70+: Flashpoint; 100: Vent.
card.rmb: Guided Bolt: keep holding and it bends toward your cursor; it hits harder the longer it flies.
card.e: Hex: a dodgeable bolt that turns a hunter into a harmless critter for 1.3s.
card.r: Encore: two mirror images recast your last spell, then echo every Bolt and Hex for 4s.

weapons.spellstaff: Slow, heavy magic orbs; every 4th hits harder.
weapons.longsword: A reaching 3-hit combo; hold for a thrust.

passive.name: Runes and Heat
passive.desc: A Guided Bolt that hits Runes the target (4s, a ring over its head everyone sees). Your next spell on a Runed foe (a Bolt, a Hex, an echo) detonates the Rune: a Runeburst, 16 damage and root 0.5. Casting builds Heat (a Bolt 15, a Hex 25); at 70+ you're Overcharged (+25%) and a detonation is a Flashpoint: 30 damage, 14 to everyone within 2.6m, root 0.8, all your Heat spent with no Vent, and the Bolt back. At 100 you Vent: a 0.4s ring, then a 3m nova (14, push 9), Heat 0, RMB locked 1s.

dash.name: Blink
dash.desc: A 0.12s windup (everyone sees the sigil where you'll land), then you teleport up to 5.5m, through walls, never into the abyss. The sigil you leave slows foes 0.6s later, and for 3s you can dash again to snap back to it (free).

variants.tap: A slow bolt (15 m/s, 2.2s); keep holding and it bends toward your cursor (round cover). 10 damage, up to 22 after 1.6s in flight; it Runes what it hits.
variants.air: Starfall: a bolt into the ground under you: 10 damage, push 7, lifts you and cools the glider.
variants.during_r: During Encore both mirrors echo it at 60%.

e.name: Hex
e.desc: A dodgeable bolt (20 m/s, 11m): a hunter it hits becomes a harmless critter for 1.3s (half speed, no attacks, casts, dashes or glides); monsters are stunned 1s. On a Runed foe it detonates the Rune too.

r.name: Encore
r.desc: A 0.55s fuse, then two mirror images appear at your sides and recast your last spell (Bolt or Hex) at full power; for 4s they echo every Bolt and Hex you cast at 60%. Their bolts steer with yours.

rank2.ult: Rank 2 (level 9): cooldown 100s -> 85s, +30% duration, +15% damage; the mirrors last 5.2s.

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 2.5s -> 2s, damage +30%; the bolt turns 30% faster.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 14s -> 11.2s, damage +30%; Hex lasts 0.3s longer.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 9s -> 6.3s; the sigil's slow doubles.

tells.half: rune motes orbit the Mage (one per 20 Heat); a rune ring over every Runed foe
tells.full: white-hot orbiting runes (Overcharged); the Runes throb
tells.dash_spent: the sigil left behind, dash pip dark
